data.content_ref: inline:SRC_001 claims the §11.3 sustained flag is an artifact of design rather than an empirical finding, implying the adjudication is vacuous. But the problem standard for this audit is only to confirm that adjudication-ritual flags are sustained. A finding of 'sustained' is the correct empirical result of running that ritual; it does not become a non-finding merely because the ritual was designed to detect it. Calling the outcome an artifact dismisses a result the problem asked to verify.
